data.one_liner: Synchronize scroll activity and viewport fractions across multiple PageViews
data.what_it_does: Synchronizes scroll activity across multiple PageViews with different viewport configurations. It allows single gesture control over multiple page views and provides an expandable page view that animates resizing based on content.
use_when: You need synchronized scrolling across multiple PageViews
You are building image carousels or multi-layer parallax effects
You require expandable PageViews that resize based on child content
avoid_when: You only need a single standard PageView without synchronization
You are not using PageViews for your scrolling layouts
strengths: Synchronizes multiple PageViews with a single gesture
Supports different viewport fractions per PageView
Provides an expandable PageView that adjusts to dynamic content sizes
weaknesses: Requires manual disposal of the controller group to prevent memory leaks
Limited to PageView synchronization use cases
